title: Robust CSV Line Parser
prompt:
Implement `parse_csv_line(line: str) -> list[str]` in `solution.py` without using the standard `csv` module.
- Comma `,` is the delimiter.
- Fields enclosed in double quotes `"` can contain commas.
- A double quote inside quotes is escaped by two double quotes `""`.
- Leading and trailing spaces around unquoted fields should be trimmed.
- Quoted fields preserve their exact internal spaces.
